text_block_list.text: While out together with King Halo—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Feels a bit too early to head back 
home just yet.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, there's a boutique nearby fit for a 
King, why don't we drop by and take a 
look?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not asking you to buy it for me. 
We're just looking, so rest easy."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's go! Fufu, I wonder if they 
have any new bags out.
(Bzzzt, bzzzt)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh? I have a message from Sky-san. I 
wonder what it could be...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~... Being called at a time like this 
is just awful timing...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Sky-san and I were on harvest duty today. 
I totally forgot and went off playing 
instead.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I was totally ready to go shopping at 
designer boutiques, so why are we 
harvesting carrots...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Harvesting carrots...? You certainly have 
peculiar tastes, but I don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're here. Even you came along, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Phew~...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...What is it? What's wrong?
choice_data_list:
I was just about to head where I wanted to 
go when I got called over...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I'm fine, really. I ended up carelessly 
forgetting my turn to harvest anyway... 
*sigh*..."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Pull yourself together! If King's down in 
the dumps, I won't be able to slack off on 
harvesting... whoops."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainer-san. Do you know any way 
to boost King's spirits?
choice_data_list:
At this rate, let's just enjoy the 
harvest!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What do you mean, 'enjoying the 
harvest'?
choice_data_list: Whoever harvests the biggest carrot wins!
Whoever harvests the biggest carrot wins!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that looks fun~. Isn't that getting 
you fired up too, King?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I'd fall for such child's 
play, you know.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh well, let's just get this over with 
quickly.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I did it! It's the biggest, most 
first-class carrot ever!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: As expected! King! You're the best!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Whew, I'm just so glad King's back to her 
usual energetic self."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
See? King is first-rate at harvesting too! 
Ohohoho!
choice_data_list: Glad to see you having fun.
I'm glad to see you're having fun.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
See? King is first-rate at harvesting too! 
Ohohoho!
choice_data_list: Glad to see you having fun.
I'm glad to see you're having fun.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ah! I-I'm not being carried away, okay?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm just blowing off steam because I 
couldn't go to the brand shop, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: King is so easy to read.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm telling you, that's not it!

And so, I enjoyed the carrot harvest along 
with King Halo and the others.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
O-ho-ho-ho! As expected of the King's 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes! As long as we don't give up, there's 
always a chance of victory!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well, King is going to unearth an even 
bigger carrot, just you watch!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, that's the spirit! Look, there 
are some well-grown carrots over there!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You're right, I wonder if this will break 
the record! I'm not giving this up!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Do your best~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Not that it's my place to say, Trainer, 
but you really do know how to handle King~

And so, I enjoyed the carrot harvest along 
with King Halo and the others.
